text: 100 users each need 1 Mb/s when active and are active 5% of the time. What capacity does circuit switching require to serve all of them?
choices: It depends on the switching technology
explanation: Circuit switching reserves capacity for the duration of each session, so serving all 100 simultaneously requires 100 Mb/s — idle 95% of the time. Statistical multiplexing over a 20 Mb/s link serves the same population with an overflow probability under one in ten million.
